row.evidence: mParticle's Users and Roles guide covers adding users in the UI and SAML/SSO set up with mParticle's support team; no SCIM or automated user provisioning is documented anywhere in docs.mparticle.com.
row.notes: New row. Quote-only: mparticle.com/pricing redirects to the Contact Us page. mParticle (customer data platform) offers SAML SSO via Auth0, configured by mParticle support. No SCIM: searched every page in the docs sitemap, the Platform API reference, the security page, and the Okta catalogue (no app). The Platform API exposes read-only Users (list/get), a Custom Access Roles API for role definitions, and an experimental Audit Logs API, all with OAuth client credentials. Legacy Analytics (deprecated) had Enterprise-only SAML with JIT. Status none by absence (medium); the help centre returned 403.

plans.name: mParticle (quote-only)
plans.notes: mparticle.com/pricing redirects to the Contact Us page; no public tiers. SAML SSO is set up through mParticle support.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint, SCIM guide or IdP provisioning app found anywhere in the mParticle docs (all 833 sitemap pages searched for 'SCIM', 'user provisioning' and 'Okta').

auth.notes: Client ID/secret from the API Credentials screen exchanged at https://sso.auth.mparticle.com/oauth/token; bearer tokens last about 8 hours and cannot be revoked.

endpoints.purpose: Get a specific user (example path as documented)
Create, modify or delete custom roles (upload manifest)
List permission tasks for custom roles

limitations.text: Custom roles are assigned to users only through the mParticle UI.

user_api.notes: The Platform API's Users resource is read-only (list users, get a user). The Custom Access Roles API manages role definitions; roles are assigned to users in the UI. User invites and deletes are done in the UI.

okta.notes: OIN search for 'mparticle' returns no results.

entra.notes: No mParticle tutorial in the Entra SaaS app tutorial index (toc.json).

fallbacks.notes: Platform SAML SSO is configured by mParticle support on Auth0; the docs do not say whether platform SSO creates users on first sign-in. The legacy (deprecated) Analytics product auto-creates accounts on SSO login, Enterprise only.
